purpose: Refine the accepted pre60 information architecture into a brighter, more restrained and professional design system; repair the desktop Navigator promotion; reduce visual noise and mobile scan length without removing routes, content, legal areas, community categories, or professional funnel steps.

baselineDefects: Desktop Navigator promotion used four independent grid children in a three-column layout, forcing the heading into a narrow vertical word column.
Emoji practice icons could render inconsistently or as missing-glyph boxes and did not match the restrained professional brand.
Multiple historical style layers left excessive gradients, rounded surfaces, and default shadows across otherwise improved pre60 pages.
Phone legal-area and community scans exposed too many cards before the user reached progressive-disclosure controls.
The professional tour retained dense nested cards and oversized headings even after the pre60 content-length repair.
repairs: Navigator promotion now has a structured content group and one clear action, with a responsive two-column desktop and one-column phone layout.
Six home practice icons use stable numbered markers instead of platform-dependent emoji.
Shared white surfaces, navy and teal color, six-to-nine-pixel radii, lighter borders, fewer default shadows, and tighter type scale now govern public and professional pages.
Phone legal-area and community initial scans show six choices while desktop retains twelve legal areas and nine community categories.
Professional-tour steps use a simpler numbered rail, flatter nested surfaces, and reduced mobile heading and spacing density.
remainingIntentionalLength: All 69 legal areas remain available through search and the Show all control.
All 21 community categories remain available through search and the Show all control.
All seven attorney-tour steps remain available because they represent distinct acquisition, operations, compliance, and handoff decisions.

navigationAndLinkAudit.moduleDestinationRule: Every same-origin link exposed by the six main module funnels must return HTTP 200 in candidate qualification.
